payload.blocks: Landing phase 5 (branch head-communication-agent-to-agent/p05b, reviewed, fix applied), then phases 6 and 7. Likely every other head's land too.
payload.headline: Run fgos git recover in the main checkout so phase 5 of plan 261125-2313 can land?

parts.cause: An interrupted Git operation in the main checkout needs recovery. The lead cannot read it (fgos git status: Read-only file system from the cage) and fgos git recover from the head window answers ref-invalid.

options.does: Owner (or supervisor, if it can) runs `fgos git recover` in /home/vantt/projects/forgent outside the cage; if it prints a main-checkout-reset command, decide that separately.
options.gain: Settles the interrupted operation; lands resume for all heads.
options.harm: None; recover never deletes worktrees, locks or refs.
options.label: Run fgos git recover

options.does: Phase 5 stays parked with the branch ready.
options.harm: Phases 5 to 7 and probably other lands stay blocked.
options.label: Leave it

parts.recommendation: Run fgos git recover: it is the repository's documented door for this refusal and is non-destructive.

scope.allows: Running fgos git recover in the main checkout; the lead then retries the land.
scope.forbids: Hand-made resets, deleting refs, worktrees or locks.

parts.what: fgos land head-communication-agent-to-agent/p05b was refused twice (tickets c-18463, c-19108) at 'fast-forward main: resource-recovery-required'. Main is at e932a25aa; the branch is not on main.
